fusions.name: Split Left and Right
fusions.desc: A snap that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then branches to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Fanning Out
fusions.desc: The pack fans out in a cone 5 tiles ahead of you, which deals 12 damage to everything caught in it, each with a 30% chance of [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: The Other Road
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and you finish 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Either Path
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Its effect increases by 9% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
